goal: The session screen steers the viewed run through the existing control-command channel -- compose-box say, an interrupt key binding, and approve/reject with optional feedback when AWAITING_APPROVAL -- rendering each enqueued command as pending until its harness.control_command_applied/_failed event arrives and disabling all steering on inactive runs.

relevant: .flywheel/specs/00020-FEATURE-tui-operator-console.md -- FR-5, FR-6, and the steering rows of the Error Handling table are this task's surface
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/invoker_client.py -- CONTROL_COMMAND_SAY/_INTERRUPT/_APPROVE/_REJECT (:64-68) and the per-kind payload validation (:209-230) the enqueued payloads must satisfy
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/store_protocols.py -- enqueue_command (:487) is the only write the TUI performs
packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/workflow.py -- the existing steer/interrupt/approve/reject CLI producers to mirror for payload shapes
references: packages/flywheel/tests -- existing control-command tests show the enqueue payload shapes and the applied/failed event names to key feedback off
constraints: The TUI is an enqueue-only writer: it never claims or applies commands; the in-process watcher remains the sole claimant/applier.
Each action produces exactly one control_commands row with the correct kind and payload, via enqueue_command with the existing CONTROL_COMMAND_* constants -- no new verbs.

An enqueued command renders as pending until the matching harness.control_command_applied or _failed event appears in the run's stream; applied say turns then render in the transcript, failures surface the event's error detail inline.
A command never claimed (dead worker) stays pending indefinitely -- no false delivered state.

Steering verbs are disabled when the viewed run is not in an active status; re-check status at submit time so a run that left the active set between render and submit gets an inline not-steerable notice and no enqueue.
Approve/reject affordances (reject accepting optional feedback) appear only when the run is AWAITING_APPROVAL, alongside the gate instruction.

Cover with Textual Pilot tests over a seeded store: one enqueue row per action with correct kind/payload, the pending-to-applied transition (seed the applied event after a delay), pending-to-failed, and verbs unavailable on a DONE run.
No set_model UI surface in v1 (the channel supports it; deliberately unbound).
No changes to flywheel core, the watcher, or control-command semantics.
Run mcp__ide__getDiagnostics on every .py file touched and fix all Pylance errors in the same turn.
Commit with a Conventional Commits feat: message before emitting intent=verify.
non_goals: No auto-steering or policy-driven intervention; operator-driven only.
No new control-command verbs, store columns, or protocol methods.
No changes to how the watcher claims or applies commands.
edge_cases: Two TUI instances steering one store: both are enqueue-only; claim-once semantics in the watcher prevent double-apply.
Reject with empty feedback is valid (feedback is optional).
An applied event for a command enqueued by another producer (CLI) must not be matched to this instance's pending markers.
